The collection

Ten paintings, released one at a time

Rather than opening all at once, the collection will be released one painting at a time. The works in What We Make of Free Rein are in progress in Kimberly’s studio. Each original will be added here as it is finished and catalogued, with its medium, dimensions and price. Every original comes with a signed certificate of authenticity and free insured shipping in the US.
